title: HD 209458: TESS sector 56 light curve
facility: TESS, camera 1, CCD 2, 2-minute cadence, SPOC spoc-5.0.96-20230729
credit: TESS, sector 56 (NASA; SPOC light curve from MAST)

license.statement: NASA mission data, released through MAST without restriction on reuse. MAST asks that work using its data acknowledge the mission and the archive.

citations.text: TESS light curves from MAST (Ricker et al. 2015, JATIS 1, 014003)

reductions: QUALITY: any nonzero flag drops the cadence (1288 dropped)
TIME, PDCSAP_FLUX, PDCSAP_FLUX_ERR: a cadence without a finite value in all three is dropped (0 dropped)
bin: a bin with fewer than 3 kept cadences is dropped (3 dropped)
20-minute bins average 10 two-minute cadences each, which rounds ingress and egress to a bin.
Flux is kept to 1 ppm and its error to 5 ppm.
